observations: All Loop 5 platform data, requests, responses, images, failures, browser authority, and credentials references were synthetic and processed offline.
No real Chengfeng host, account, credential, cookie, signed URL, browser profile, request, response, image, or platform write was used.
No legacy project, database, browser profile, launcher, runtime, port, process, log, cache, or application-data directory was read, executed, attached to, reused, stopped, or changed.
No Windows DNS, proxy, VPN, routing, hosts file, or global browser setting was changed.
No real PaddleOCR, CPU OCR, GPU OCR, CUDA runtime, model, cloud OCR, or production document was loaded.
Every project Python command used the repository .venv.
The connector exposes exactly three read operations and no generic request, settlement confirmation, payment, receipt cancellation, or platform mutation API.
The frozen transport uses an HTTPS .invalid origin and contains no socket, HTTP client, Playwright, or real browser implementation.
The connector runtime validates browser authority before each frozen read; the main process rechecks it around staged-file verification; SQLite checks it again inside the commit transaction.
Connector results contain only versioned metadata and command-scoped relative file references. Large payloads, credentials, tokens, signed URLs, and raw failures do not cross as inline result fields.

Command staging is cleaned after consumption. Safe orphan staging is recoverable, active commands are retained, and unknown, nested, symlink, reparse, reserved-name, cross-command, hash, size, and media mismatches are rejected.
Committed images use the existing content-addressed evidence store and SQLite evidence reference/checkpoint tables; raw fencing tokens and image bytes are absent from checkpoint JSON.
Technical connector and infrastructure failures remain technical failures and are not converted into finance-review business items.
The normal local console remains wired to deterministic fake business adapters and cannot enable real platform access.
environment_limit: One symlink-path test was skipped because the current Windows account lacks symlink creation privilege. The implementation checks both symlink mode and Windows reparse attributes, and non-privileged path, traversal, reserved-name, cross-command, hash, size, media, and unsafe-staging cases passed.
